rules: Blue Player card for San Francisco. Port: the compass has an anchor.
Two scratch boxes, searched independently. State 2 is land only. State 3 is sea only. State 4 is both.
Land: put 3 Supply cubes into this city from the reserve, instead of the stockpile.
Sea: the same lost haven as Los Angeles. Open door 60 and add it to the board, or gain 1 action if 60 is already open.
Neither result is a companion. Each is resolved when its box is scratched.
Goes to the reserve when the package is opened. The other San Francisco Player card is card 16.
notes: Card id 914. State card ids: state 2 is 1002, state 3 is 1001, state 4 is 1000.
Printed code P1-17b stays on every scratched face.
